title: eng-org-sync-playbook-snapshot-aug-24-2027
content:
Context: This is the snapshot from the engineering org-wide sync run on 2027-08-24 (60 minutes). Goal: align platform, serving runtime, SRE, and product on the next 6 weeks of work, highlight risks, and capture cross-team asks. Notes below are intentionally pragmatic — action owners and short win/lift estimates are included.

Opening (5m)
- Quick state: shipping cadence steady; Dedicated pilot onboarding is consuming most infra capacity for next 2 sprints. Thanks to infra for the fast capacity carveouts.
- Housekeeping: new on-call escalation runbook v2 posted (linked). Please review if you maintain a runtime shard.

Highlights (10m)
- Serving runtime: continuous-batching improvements deployed to canary clusters; 50–60% reduction in median cpu-util per token for small payloads (Evan). Observed 95p latency unchanged for <512 tokens. Next: extend kernel selection logic for long-context models.
- Dedicated: first paid Dedicated contract signed (enterprise customer: FinOps pilot). Onboarding checklist mostly green; networking & KMS items pending in Private-deployments. Account team expects production traffic in September.
- Private: Privacy pilot in final integration with customer that requires HSM-backed keys. P0 items: cert rotation automation (Ruth) and documentation for air-gapped uplift.
- Observability/Console: rollout of trace-level token-cost breakdown alpha to 10 internal routes. Early feedback: great signal for cost regressions but high cardinality in traces; platform-engineering to propose sampling guardrails.

Operational metrics snapshot (picked numbers, week ending 2027-08-22)
- Hosted API 99p p50 latency: 45ms p50 / 220ms p95 for small gen requests
- Token cost delta week-over-week: -8% (optimizations + caching)
- Total active Dedicated clusters: 4 (2 in us-west, 1 eu-west, 1 ap-south)
- Incidents: 1 Sev2 (cache-eviction regression) resolved within 2.5 hours. Postmortem link in linked_artifacts.

Decisions & policy notes (5m)
- Rollout policy update: any model variant that changes tokenizer or logits distribution requires a canary with fidelity checks in Optimize before traffic ramp. Effective immediately.
- Autoscale policy for Dedicated: default min-replicas bumped to 2 for low-latency tiers to avoid cold-warm spikes during bursty traffic.

Cross-team blockers (10m)
- KV cache memory leak (SRE + serving-runtime): regression traced to LRU expiry behavior after recent pooling changes. Action: Diego to lead hotfix; estimate 2d. Jira: INF-2345.
- Trace cardinality blowup in Console alpha: product + observability to define sampling strategy. Action: Priya to draft sampling guardrail doc by 2027-08-30.
- Private deployment cert automation: dependency on release-engineering's signing pipeline for air-gapped bundles. Action: Ruth to coordinate with release-eng; blocker until 2027-09-06.

Action items (owner — ETA — notes)
- Diego Alvarez — hotfix KV cache leak rolled to canary — 2027-08-26 — prioritize to avoid repeated evictions on small-serving pools.
- Priya Kapoor — sampling guardrail proposal + example config for Console — 2027-08-30 — include per-route defaults and a safety cap on trace retention.
- Evan Li — extend kernel selector to support long-context heuristics (prototype) — 2027-09-07 — unblock model team experiments with 4k/8k contexts.
- Ruth Nakamura — cert rotation automation playbook for private deployment — 2027-09-06 — finalize runbook and integration test.
- Maya Chen — compile rollout checklist enforcement in CI for model-variant changes — 2027-08-31 — integrate Optimize eval gating.

Quick wins (nice-to-have, 1–3 days)
- Add a small dashboard tile showing token-cost delta per model for last 7 days (Platform Observability) — owner: observability team.
- Shortcut link in Console to jump from per-route traces to the model-variant page — owner: console-and-tooling; small UI patch.

Risk register (short)
- Capacity concentration: Dedicated onboarding + FinOps spikes in September could push hosted backpressure if burst policy not configured. Mitigation: pre-reserve burst capacity; ops to publish emergency routing policy.
- Model regressions post-quantization: Optimize team to run expanded eval set on quantized variants; any >3% QA drop must block traffic ramp.

Q&A highlights from chat (15m)
- Q: Will the Dedicated contract require changes in our SLA exposure? A: Sales and legal negotiated a tiered SLA; platform only needs to ensure 99.9% region uptime, no changes to API contract.
- Q: Are we planning more hosted regions? A: Yes — eu-north and ap-southeast targeted by Q4; release-eng to share region rollout plan.
- Q: Impact on cost for customers if we enable KV caching aggressively? A: Most customers see token-cost reduction; edge-cases exist for highly divergent request prefixes — product to add FAQ.

Parking lot / follow-ups (not blocking)
- Revisit canary duration policy (default 2h) — suggestion to make it traffic-aware.
- Explore small GPUs pool for cheap eval workloads (Optimize + research) — sketch backlog item.

Closing (wrap up + comms)
- Next org sync penciled for 2027-09-07. Owners, please update your ticket statuses in JIRA and ping the channel with any slippage.
- Comms: Maya to draft a short summary for execs and CS by 2027-08-26 with Dedicated onboarding status and potential customer impacts.

Appendix: links and short refs
- Postmortem: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/INC-2027-08-19-cache-eviction
- Playbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/pages/ENG-Playbook
- Key Jira tickets: INF-2345 (kv-cache), SRE-987 (seeding incident), DED-102 (dedicated onboarding checklist)

Notes to maintainers
- This doc is a working snapshot intended for internal distribution. Add follow-ups directly as comments in the JIRA tickets above. If you copy or extract sections for customer-facing comms, tag product and legal for review.
